stem.text: The enthalpy change for neutralisation of $\text{HNO}_3\text{(aq)}$ with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ is $-57.0\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

In an experiment, $20.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $4.00\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{HNO}_3$ is mixed with $30.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $2.00\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{NaOH}$ in an insulated container. The initial temperature of both solutions is $25.0\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
It can be assumed that the heat capacity of the product mixture is $4.2\,\text{J cm}^{-3}\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}^{-1}$ and that there are no heat losses.
What is the maximum final temperature of the mixture?
